title: Perfect 5BR Gilbert Retreat-Heated Pool+Waterslide
description:
Bring the whole crew to this fun-filled 5BR Gilbert getaway! Splash in the private pool, fire up the BBQ, and let the kids take over the game room while you relax in stylish comfort. Bright, open living spaces, a fully stocked kitchen, and fast WiFi make it easy to feel at home. Just minutes to Downtown Gilbert, parks, golf, and family-friendly dining—perfect for making unforgettable memories in the sun!

 The space 
• 5 bedrooms | 9 beds | 2.5 bathrooms – ideal for up to two families, a golf foursome, or a group getaway.
• Single-story layout keeps everyone connected; vaulted ceilings and large windows flood the home with Arizona sunshine.
• Fast Wi-Fi and smart TVs throughout mean work calls, streaming marathons, or a quick upload of poolside photos are never a hassle.

Outdoor Oasis
Vacation mode officially starts in the backyard.
• Sparkling private pool that can be heated (fee applies) plus a built-in slide for endless kid-approved laps.
• Gas BBQ grill and outdoor dining set—perfect for sunset burgers or early-morning pancakes.
• Sun loungers, shade umbrellas, and plenty of seating so everyone can claim a favorite perch.

Entertainment & Comfort
• Dedicated game room stocked with board games and space to spread out.
• Open-concept living area with a large sectional—movie night, anyone?
• Central air conditioning keeps the desert heat at bay.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms
• Primary: queen bed, smart TV, ensuite access to a full bath with tub/shower combo.
• Bedroom 2: queen bed.
• Bedroom 3: queen bed.
• Bedroom 4: two twin beds.
• Bedroom 5: double twin (twin over twin trundle).
• Two full bathrooms, both with fresh towels, starter toiletries, and plenty of counter space.

Kitchen & Dining
• Fully stocked kitchen: stainless appliance suite, dishwasher, drip coffee maker, blender, and all the cookware you’ll need from morning smoothies to family feasts.
• Breakfast bar for casual bites plus a dining table that seats eight—game night central after dinner.

 Other things to note 
Welcome to your family’s new favorite vacation spot—right in the heart of Gilbert 
This 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath home was designed for fun, connection, and easy living. From pool days to game nights, there’s something here for every age (yes, adults included).
Backyard = Vacation Mode ON 
Step outside and you’re instantly on vacation.
• Private heated pool for all-day splashing
• Easy to activate waterslide for all to use
• Outdoor BBQ for family cookouts
• Plenty of space to lounge, dine, and unwind

Where Memories Happen 
Inside, the home is bright, open, and made for gathering.
• Spacious living area for movie nights
• Game room to keep kids (and grown-ups) entertained
• Fully stocked kitchen for everything from pancakes to big family dinners
• Smart TVs + fast WiFi for when you need a little downtime
Room for Everyone 
With 5 comfortable bedrooms, everyone gets their own space—perfect for multiple families or big groups traveling together.
Location You’ll Love 
You’re just minutes from some of Gilbert’s best spots:
• Downtown Gilbert – restaurants, treats, and weekend vibes
• Parks and playgrounds for the kids
• Golf courses for a quick round
• Shopping family-friendly dining nearby
Why guests keep coming back 
Clean, well-maintained, and professionally managed with attention to every detail—so you can focus on what matters most: enjoying your time together.
Pack your swimsuits, bring your crew, and get ready for sunshine, laughs, and memories that last long after checkout.
